title: MindOS Reading Analysis Report
description: Constrains the structure of Claude-generated reading analysis markdown. Every report MUST satisfy these rules.

layer1.description: Surface facts — reading stats, top books, note counts.

layer2.description: Association — category shifts, scholar reclassification, theme connections. Must cite at least one evidence source.

layer3.description: Narrative — core narrative 1-2 sentences, direction of thinking movement, one notable signal. Must include confidence level.

reflection.description: Single reflection question. ≤50 characters in Chinese, ≤60 characters total. Open-ended, connects reading to life.
